name: Universe
overview: Scripture reveals that the universe is the intentional creation of God, who in the beginning made the heavens and the earth by His powerful word. The heavens and celestial bodies, described as the work of His fingers, serve to mark time and seasons, demonstrating His sovereign design. The earth is sustained by God's power, suspended over nothing, highlighting His authority over all creation. Through the universe, God's glory and handiwork are clearly displayed, inviting us to recognize His majesty and creative wisdom.
